title: Keegan Porter
text:
I am a Business Analytics student at Brigham Young University-Idaho with a passion for leveraging data to drive strategic business decisions and scale creative projects.
My background is a blend of analytical problem-solving and hands-on entrepreneurship. Alongside my studies, I founded and operate K.Rise.Media LLC, a social media marketing agency, as well as a professional photography business. I am always looking for ways to bridge the gap between technical development and real-world application, which recently culminated in the successful launch of my mobile app, Mellom, on the iOS App Store.
Whether it is running local AI models, optimizing business operations, or telling a story through a camera lens, I love building things that work efficiently and look great.
When I am not at my computer, you can usually find me out running, mountain biking, trying to dial in my swing on the golf simulator, or practicing my Norwegian.
Feel free to explore my recent data science projects and technical coursework using the navigation menu above!

title: Data Science Projects
text:
This section contains the data science projects I am completing for my DS 250: Data Science Programming course at Brigham Young University-Idaho.
Through these projects, I apply data analytics principles to real-world datasets. The core tools used in these projects include:

Python: The primary programming language used for all logic and data manipulation.
Pandas: Used extensively for data cleansing, filtering, and structuring.
Plotly Express: Used to build interactive charts and data visualizations that tell a clear story.
Scikit-Learn: Used for introductory machine learning applications and predictive modeling.

You can navigate through my specific project write-ups and code using the sidebar or the navigation menu above.
